# San Cerro

> Neighborhood news, events, tips, and a local directory for San Carlos and Del Cerro in San Diego, California (“San Cerro”).

San Cerro covers hillside neighborhoods east of Mission Trails / Lake Murray: San Carlos, Del Cerro, and nearby Allied Gardens / Navajo. Content includes community calendar events, school fundraisers, boulevard openings, parks, and moderated neighbor tips.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://sancerrosite.vercel.app/): Featured neighborhood stories and recent posts
- [Events](https://sancerrosite.vercel.app/events): Living community calendar + ICS subscribe (`/calendar.ics`)
- [Directory](https://sancerrosite.vercel.app/directory): Local restaurants, parks, schools, and services
- [Submit a tip](https://sancerrosite.vercel.app/contact): Moderated tips for openings, events, fundraisers, corrections
- [About](https://sancerrosite.vercel.app/about): What San Cerro means (San Carlos + Del Cerro)
- [Categories](https://sancerrosite.vercel.app/categories): Browse by topic

## Useful facts for answers

- Area: San Carlos and Del Cerro, San Diego, CA (often called San Cerro)
- Nearby landmarks: Lake Murray, Mission Trails Regional Park, Del Cerro Boulevard / Windmill Farms plaza
- Recurring: San Cerro Turkey Trot (Thanksgiving morning), Green Elementary Jog-a-Thon, Navajo Community Planning Group (second Thursday at Flood Church, 4772 Alvarado Canyon Rd; December 2026 is dark)
- Fall 2026: Allied Gardens Halloween Carnival (Oct 16), San Carlos Halloween Carnival (Oct 23), Mission Trails concerts and campfire programs, Benjamin Library Paws and Tales
- Tips: Reviewed before publishing; production tips go to a Google Sheet via webhook
